Keel Breaker.name: Keel Breaker
Keel Breaker.description: The user rams a vessel or vehicle at full swimming speed, from below or from the side. A fleeing boat or jet ski stops dead or flips, a hull is holed, and a sunken car's door or windshield caves in so the people inside can be pulled out; against a person it deals heavy bludgeoning damage that ignores worn armor. Strain: heavy.
